findings.finding: Recovery fetches splits only for T before folding every gap bar. If a split occurred on skipped T-1 and T publishes first (or T's provider call fails and cron continues to T+1), the snapshot and watermark advance without that split. The later T-1 retry persists the split but excludes the already-advanced ticker, so it cannot repair the incorrect previous-all-time-high basis; subsequent publications remain wrong. The new out-of-order test uses no gap split and misses this reachable corruption of ATH evidence. `+        fetched = await provider.fetch_daily_splits(date_string)`
